title: Unfold a laptop stand and set its highest position
instruction: Fully spread the laptop stand, with both support rods seated in the slots for its highest setting. The whole stand's top-down outline must lie within the inner edges of the red tape rectangle.
context: Setting up a portable laptop stand requires coordinated manipulation of a passive scissor linkage, raising two supports, and seating separate support rods. The task tests whether a robot can assemble a stable configuration of a familiar adjustable object.
setup: Two YAM arms, 0.61 m apart, face a 1.1 x 1.3 m oak worktop with top and wrist cameras. Reference: Tonmom stand, Amazon ASIN B08G84P8ZX (purchase link in README). The ABS/silicone model is 0.24 kg, 276 x 53 x 28 mm folded, 185 mm wide open. Start folded, centered at (0.46,0) m, long axis along X, hooks toward -X. A 12 mm red tape border encloses x=[0.29,0.63], y=[-0.12,0.12] m at its inner edges. Seven slots; slot 1 nearest the front hinge is highest. No laptop.
scoring: Final-state score: +0.25 for fully spreading the stand; +0.25 for the left support rod in its highest-setting slot; +0.25 for the right rod in its highest-setting slot. These three items score independently. Only when all three hold, add +0.25 if the entire top-down outline lies within the red tape inner edges (edge contact allowed). Otherwise retain only earned quarters. Inspect spread and footprint from above and each rod seated in its slot from the side; no timed hold or force measurement.
run_limit: 2400 control steps at 20 Hz (120 simulated seconds), including 32 Dream history warmup steps. Dream ends early on full success. The scripted demo completes within the same limit.
fidelity: Approximate rigid-body PhysX model: 10 bodies, 11 passive joints and 114 convex colliders; CPU TGS at 960 Hz. Hinges, slides and rod-slot contacts act without snapping or assisted grasp constraints. Dimensions, mass, inertia and friction are estimates, not a calibrated product replica. Hinge friction is 0.002/0.0004 N m; slide friction is 0.15 N. Pads are rigid. The expert plans from measured mechanism state; Dream receives RGB and joint state only.
scores: Archived Dream-1 trajectory rescored: 0.0 at 120.0 s; scripted demo rescored: 1.0 at 105.05 s. Earlier instruction, revised four-part rubric; no new model run. Fixed layout, seed 0.
reset_notes: Restore the folded stand to the red rectangle center, long axis along X and hooks toward -X. Reset both arms to their ready pose and reset elapsed time and score. Settle under gravity for 0.5 s. No consumables or randomized placement.
